All 17 RTC/RTM function names referenced by the current mybot RTC adapter
are exported by the AArch64 library. The adapter was syntax-checked
against this package's actual public headers, not linked or run on hardware.

The vendor archive also contains x86_64 binaries. PACKAGE_INFO names the
AArch64 release, while agora_sdk/.config CONFIG_PACKAGE_INFO names x86_64.
The original metadata was inspected; target selection uses the actual ELF.
The vendor archive and extracted package are intentionally not included in
this repository. Obtain the matching package through an authorized channel,
then set AGORA_SDK_DIR and AGORA_RTC_LIBRARY when configuring the build.
